mediarift.config.preset.small.tip: Recommended: small player (75%), site zoomed out more so everything fits.
mediarift.config.preset.normal.tip: Recommended: normal player (100%). Fits most sites.
mediarift.config.buttonrow.tip: Off: the whole bottom row (back, pause, forward) disappears.
mediarift.config.hidebuttons.tip: On: the buttons disappear when the chat is closed. Off: they stay on screen.
mediarift.config.volbar.tip: A vertical volume slider next to the player (drag it with the mouse or use the mouse wheel).
mediarift.config.hidevol.tip: On: the volume slider disappears when the chat is closed. Off: it stays on screen.
mediarift.config.ticker.tip: Off: the gray bar with the song name disappears. In the chat two small buttons stay instead: open/close the window and the pin.
mediarift.config.hideticker.tip: On: the gray bar disappears when the chat is closed. Off: it stays on screen.
mediarift.config.pin.tip: Off (white pin): the player is only in the chat. Green: the player stays on screen when the chat is closed. Super (purple): the player is visible everywhere (menus, settings, outside the world) and the music keeps playing when you leave the world. You can also click the pin in the chat.
mediarift.config.keys.hint1: Click a button, then press a key (or a mouse button). To make a combination, hold Ctrl / Shift / Alt and press the key (for example Ctrl + Num 7). Esc clears the key.
mediarift.config.keys.hint2: Keys work in the game when no screen is open, even if the buttons are hidden. "Window" needs the pin (green or purple).
mediarift.player.open: Music player - click here to open
mediarift.player.idle: Nothing is playing - pick a song
mediarift.player.notready: The browser (Rinku) is not ready yet. Wait until it finishes downloading Chromium, then reopen chat.
mediarift.msg.reload.none: The player is not started yet
mediarift.msg.need_pin: Pin the player (%s) to open the window
mediarift.tools.title: MediaRift: downloading libraries
mediarift.tools.hint: Streamlink and ffmpeg are needed once, to watch live streams (Twitch, Kick, YouTube) in the player. Please wait until the download is finished.
key.mediarift.size: Player size: small / normal / big (each press = the next size)
mediarift.config.resolution.tip: Picture quality of streams (Twitch, Kick, YouTube live) and of YouTube videos. 720 = recommended. 1080 = the maximum, can be very heavy for the computer. 480 = for weak computers. A stream gives less only if the streamer sends less. Other sites keep their own quality. A running stream changes at the next start.
mediarift.config.behind.0: Window in menus: in front of the buttons
mediarift.config.behind.1: Window in menus: behind the buttons
mediarift.config.behind.tip: Where the player window is drawn in the pause menu, the title screen and other menus: in front of the buttons or behind them. (F3 hides the window.)
mediarift.tools.antivirus: If the download is not moving, please turn off your antivirus while it downloads: it often gets in the way. Restarting the game can also help.
mediarift.config.codec.vp8: Stream codec: VP8 (for very weak PCs)
mediarift.config.codec.tip: How the mod converts live streams (Twitch, Kick, YouTube live). VP9 = default, better picture. VP8 = much lighter for the processor, for very weak PCs (the picture is a bit worse), and streams on VP8 are not higher than 720p (a 1080 choice is kept, with VP9 it works again). Only streams are affected, other sites and YouTube videos are not touched. A running stream changes at the next start.
mediarift.config.opacity.window.tip: How see-through the window itself is (the site / video). 100% = normal, solid window. The lower the number, the more see-through.
mediarift.config.opacity.ui.tip: How see-through the gray song bar, the pin, the buttons (back / pause / forward) and the volume slider are. 100% = normal. The lower the number, the more see-through.
